original: WPRPLACE is a nature reserve on the island of Goeree-Overflakkee, in the Dutch province of South Holland. It is a protected natural area of ninety hectares west of Ouddorp, near Westhead lighthouse. This area consists of a creek bordered by reeds and wet grasslands and was managed by Natural Monuments in [dated source].
